quests.instruction: It begins the word Onion. It comes between L and P. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: Use the first clue to find three letters. Use the second clue to choose one.
quests.explanation: The letters between L and P are M, N and O. Only O begins Onion.
quests.funFact: A to Z has 26 letters, so every letter has exactly one place in line.

quests.instruction: Find the word that uses t and j together.
quests.hint: Cross out any word that has only one of the two letters.
quests.explanation: jacket is spelled j-a-c-k-e-t, so it has both t and j. rat has only t, and jigsaw has only j.
quests.funFact: Lowercase p and q are mirror twins that hang below the line.

quests.instruction: Look at the row: X X X Z X X X. Which letter is different from the others?
quests.hint: Compare each letter with the one next to it. Where does the pattern change?
quests.explanation: Z is the odd one. All the others are X.
quests.funFact: Capital Z is a zig-zag.

quests.instruction: Look at the last letter of jet. Which capital letter is its partner?
quests.hint: Say the letter out loud first. Then picture its twin in the other size.
quests.explanation: The last letter of jet is t. Its capital partner is T.
quests.funFact: Names of people and places begin with a capital letter.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a letter that comes after N in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Check Fox first: it begins with F. Is that letter after N?
quests.explanation: Shoe begins with S, which comes after N. Fox begins with F and Dolphin begins with D, which do not.
quests.funFact: If you know what comes before and after a letter, you can find words in a dictionary faster.

quests.instruction: Read backwards: g, f, e, d, __. Which letter fills the blank?
quests.hint: The blank is letter number 5 in a line of 5. Say the line from the start and stop there.
quests.explanation: c completes the line: g, f, e, d, c.
quests.funFact: When two words begin with the same letter, we look at the second letter to decide which comes first.

quests.instruction: Count the letter A in the word camera. How many do you find?
quests.hint: Spell camera: c-a-m-e-r-a. Count only A.
quests.explanation: camera is spelled c-a-m-e-r-a. The letter A appears 2 times.
quests.funFact: The word alphabet begins with alpha, the Greek letter that looks like a capital A.

quests.instruction: Look at jeep. What comes right after its first letter in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Hold the letter in your mind, then count one step forward or back in the alphabet song.
quests.explanation: The first letter of jeep is j. Right after it in the alphabet comes k.
quests.funFact: Lowercase k is tall, like b, d, h and l.

quests.instruction: Finish the word EG_ using the clue. A hen lays me.
quests.hint: Sound out the word with each letter. Only one makes a word that fits the clue.
quests.explanation: The word is egg. The missing letter is G.
quests.funFact: G is letter number 7 of the 26 letters, with 6 letters before it and 19 after it.

quests.instruction: Put these words in alphabet order: Apple, Yellow or Pig. Which one goes last?
quests.hint: Put the first letters in alphabet order. The word that goes with the last letter wins.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order the words go Apple, Pig, Yellow, so Yellow comes last.
quests.funFact: Yam, yoga and yak all begin with Y.

quests.instruction: It comes between m and q. It begins the word Newspaper. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: Use the first clue to find three letters. Use the second clue to choose one.
quests.explanation: The letters between m and q are n, o and p. Only n begins Newspaper.
quests.funFact: The English alphabet has 26 letters, and they always come in the same order.

quests.instruction: Which word begins with d and ends with r?
quests.hint: One word has the right start but the wrong end, and one has the right end but the wrong start.
quests.explanation: deer starts with d and ends with r. dog has the wrong ending, and otter has the wrong start.
quests.funFact: Capital D has a straight back and one big curve.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a letter that comes between H and O?
quests.hint: Check Pencil first: it begins with P. Is that letter between H and O?
quests.explanation: Jeep begins with J, which comes between H and O. Envelope begins with E and Pencil begins with P, which do not.
quests.funFact: In German, J says 'yuh', so the name Jan sounds like 'Yan'.

quests.instruction: This line skips two letters each time. Which letter fills the blank? O, R, __, X
quests.hint: Count how many letters the line skips each time, then jump again.
quests.explanation: U completes the line: O, R, U, X.
quests.funFact: Lowercase u looks like a cup that can hold water.

quests.instruction: Which letter is the fourth letter in rhino?
quests.hint: Point to each letter with your finger, starting on the left.
quests.explanation: The fourth letter of rhino is n.
quests.funFact: Rhyming words often end with the same letters, like cat and hat.

quests.instruction: Which word has both h and r in it?
quests.hint: Spell each word out loud and listen for h, then listen for r.
quests.explanation: shark is spelled s-h-a-r-k, so it has both h and r. hand has only h, and gorilla has only r.
quests.funFact: Reading gets faster when your eyes learn to notice small differences, like a dot or a curve.

quests.instruction: Look at the first letter of HEN. Which small letter is its partner?
quests.hint: Two steps: pick out the letter, then switch it to the other size.
quests.explanation: The first letter of HEN is H. Its small partner is h.
quests.funFact: Days and months begin with capital letters in English, like Monday and March.

quests.instruction: It comes between A and E. It begins the word Bee. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: List the letters between A and E. Then check which one begins Bee.
quests.explanation: The letters between A and E are B, C and D. Only B begins Bee.
quests.funFact: Many children learn the alphabet order with a song, because a tune makes a long list easier to remember.

quests.instruction: Read backwards: p, __, n, m, l. Which letter fills the blank?
quests.hint: Each letter comes just before the one on its left. Keep going.
quests.explanation: The full line is p, o, n, m, l, so the missing letter is o.
quests.funFact: Z is the last letter. In some countries it is called 'zed'.

quests.instruction: Take the first letter of octopus. Which letter comes right after it in the alphabet?
quests.hint: First find the first letter of octopus. Then sing the alphabet from there.
quests.explanation: The first letter of octopus is O. Right after it in the alphabet comes P.
quests.funFact: In phone and photo, p teams up with h to say 'fff'.

quests.instruction: Which letter turns mat into bat?
quests.hint: Say 'at' with a new first sound to get bat.
quests.explanation: bat starts with B, while mat starts with m. The rest, 'at', stays the same.
quests.funFact: A word with a silent letter still needs that letter when you spell it.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a letter that comes between F and L?
quests.hint: Check Vest first: it begins with V. Is that letter between F and L?
quests.explanation: Hook begins with H, which comes between F and L. Vest begins with V and Salt begins with S, which do not.
quests.funFact: Dictionaries, phone contact lists and library shelves all use alphabet order.

quests.instruction: Put these words in alphabet order: Banana, Island or Up. Which one goes first?
quests.hint: Put the first letters in alphabet order. The word that goes with the first letter wins.
quests.explanation: In alphabet order the words go Banana, Island, Up, so Banana comes first.
quests.funFact: B is letter number 2 of the 26 letters, with 1 letters before it and 24 after it.

quests.instruction: Count the letter Y: Y Y T Y Y T T. How many are there?
quests.hint: Only count Y. Ignore its look-alike, T.
quests.explanation: There are 4 of the letter Y in the row. The other letters are T.
quests.funFact: The name of Y, 'why', sounds just like the question word.

quests.instruction: It comes between e and i. It begins the word Grapes. Which letter is it?
quests.hint: Use the first clue to find three letters. Use the second clue to choose one.
quests.explanation: The letters between e and i are f, g and h. Only g begins Grapes.
quests.funFact: The name 'gee' rhymes with bee, tree and key.

quests.instruction: Count the letter N in the word onion. How many do you find?
quests.hint: Spell onion: o-n-i-o-n. Count only N.
quests.explanation: onion is spelled o-n-i-o-n. The letter N appears 2 times.
quests.funFact: You can learn new words by looking at their first and last letters.

quests.instruction: Jump over two letters each time: __, n, q, t. What goes in the blank?
quests.hint: Look at the jump from n to the next shown letter. Keep making the same jump.
quests.explanation: k completes the line: k, n, q, t.
quests.funFact: Kite, key and kangaroo all begin with K.

quests.instruction: Find the first letter in queen. Which capital letter matches it?
quests.hint: Find the first letter first. Then think of its capital partner.
quests.explanation: The first letter of queen is q. Its capital partner is Q.
quests.funFact: Capital Q looks like O with a little tail.

quests.instruction: Which word has both e and c in it?
quests.hint: Two of the words have only one of the letters. Look for e and c in the same word.
quests.explanation: ice is spelled i-c-e, so it has both e and c. quiet has only e, and tractor has only c.
quests.funFact: The letters 'ee' and 'ea' can both say 'ee', as in bee and sea.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a letter that comes after Q in the alphabet?
quests.hint: Check Football first: it begins with F. Is that letter after Q?
quests.explanation: Violin begins with V, which comes after Q. City begins with C and Football begins with F, which do not.
quests.funFact: V is one of the less common letters in English words.
